comments:
This manuscript, kept at the Cultural Palace of Nationalities in Beijing (CPN), is discussed in <<van der Kuijp 1994 [4TBERVZD]>>: 6-7.
In view of the signature, it was part of the 'Bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang collection. [8H6M69W4] does not list any item with the signature "phyi zha 12."

item_description:
Description of the manuscript particularities in [76BBFCQ4]: 63-64.
Fol. 1 missing. 
The signature “phyi zha 12” appears on top of fol. 2a in the middle, on the cover page before the second chapter (fol. 48a), but is not visible (maybe faded) on the cover page of the third chapter (fol. 92a).
Annotations: 5(45) on fol. 48a; 6(32) on fol. 92a
